fieldNotes.location: 33 Coffee Lane, Waterbury VT 05676 - the Pilgrim Park office campus, Keurig Green Mountain's original/legacy Waterbury site. Roster pin (44.336491,-72.755118, APPROXIMATE) landed in downtown Waterbury; corrected ~430 m SE to the Pilgrim Park complex. Confirmed via web (VT Farm to Plate, Yelp, Waze all list 33 Coffee Lane) and 2023 Street View showing a multi-building office campus with an entrance sign.
fieldNotes.facilityCharacter: This is predominantly a CORPORATE OFFICE / R&D campus, not a freight/distribution truck yard. The original Green Mountain Coffee roasting operations were historically here, but KDP coffee production is now consolidated at Essex Junction. Street View and satellite show multi-story office buildings surrounded by large employee car parking lots - no loading-dock banks, no trailer drop yards, no truck gate or guard shack.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck entrance - the campus has open driveways off Pilgrim Park Rd / Coffee Lane serving car parking lots. No barrier arm, gate or checkpoint.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth anywhere on the campus.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Essentially none of consequence - at most a couple of small service/loading doors at a building rear; banded 0-10. A handful of box trucks/vans seen near one building (counted as ~3 trailersVisible) appear to be service/parcel vehicles, not freight trailers.
fieldNotes.railServed: An active rail line (Amtrak/NECR Waterbury station corridor) runs alongside the W edge of the campus, but there is NO rail spur into the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Small-town Vermont setting on the edge of Waterbury village; per the rubric's small-town guidance, classified Rural.
fieldNotes.yardRelevance: Low YardFlow relevance - office site, minimal freight operations. confidence set to medium because the site is unambiguous but does not present a meaningful truck yard to audit.

citations.claim: KDP will not reopen its leased Waterbury offices; ~200 workers permanently remote; Pilgrim Park space now occupied by other businesses.
Keurig closed its Waterbury early-production facility.

verification.rationale: KDP closed Waterbury production (2019) and vacated offices (remote since 2021); site now occupied by other tenants - no KDP operating freight yard.
